summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload; scope-impersonates Verdocs SDK
details: The package publishes as `@hubsync/web-sdk-react` but its description and README both refer to Verdocs (`@verdocs/web-sdk-react`), impersonating an unrelated vendor's React SDK. Its `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13), makes it executable in a temp directory, and uses that runtime to execute a package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large shuffled constant table `n7gIxM`, hex-mangled identifiers) with no functional relationship to a React SDK. Fetching an alternate language runtime purely to execute an opaque in-package payload at install time — while masquerading as a legitimate vendor SDK — is a dropper pattern: the Bun runtime bypasses Node-based scanners, and the obfuscated payload hides its behavior from install-time inspection. Installing this package causes the obfuscated code to run automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
